message: Fern silently drops enum value "One" from the generated SDK: its name "One" is also the name of the earlier value "1". Give each value a unique name with x-fern-enum.
Fern silently drops enum value "InProgress" from the generated SDK: its name "InProgress" is also the name of the earlier value "in-progress". Give each value a unique name with x-fern-enum.
